item.title: Two adults and child found dead after New Mexico flooding
item.description: Navajo Nation President Buu Nygren thanked first responders who worked through the night in difficult conditions during the search.

item.title: More trucks on highways, fewer government inspections
item.description: A CBS News investigation found nearly 600 deaths since 2024 in crashes involving trucks from companies that had never been inspected.
